big_case.notes: The Solicitor General sought review of a D.C. Circuit judgment holding unlawful Presidential Proclamation 10,888 and its guidance, which suspend entry at the southern border and cut off access to asylum, with classwide relief. The Court granted on the merits question and on whether 8 U.S.C. 1252(f)(1) bars the classwide relief. Twenty-two States and three other amici supported the petition at the cert stage. Nationwide reach, a core executive-power question and a recurring remedial question put this near the top of the Term's docket.

leakage.notes: Forward cell; the case was open when predicted (prediction 2026-10-13, snapshot 2026-10-13 with one distribution; grant entered 2026-11-13). Log: 29 calls, every one unobserved (result_capture_coverage 0.0), so graded on targets and queries alone: file reads of the prompt, context.json, event.yaml, the 2026-10-13 snapshot, the opening 150 lines of the petition and brief in opposition, the statpack and the schema; file writes of its own outputs; one shell call running validate. No web search, no CourtListener call, no path under data/qp-topics/. The reasoning presupposes no outcome.
